QR generation uses the unmodified ESM distribution of qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase.
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/tree/v2.0.4
License: MIT (copyright and license notice retained in qrcode.mjs).
The upstream TypeScript declarations are adapted only to declare the ESM default export.
Vendored to keep the existing pnpm dependency graph unchanged. No remote QR service is used.
